answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the pulse of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Reaching the copper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
